 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Spark Wednesday result for October 21, 2026
 Here is the official result of the Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Spark Wednesday at 1 pm on October 21, 2026 
 Published: October 21, 2026, 2:04 PM Updated: October 21, 2026, 8:27 PM By Eastern Mirror News Lottery Share WhatsApp Channel Get EM Bites DIMAPUR — The   Nagaland State Lottery results  for the  Dear Spark Wednesday draw, held on Wednesday, at 1 pm, have been declared. 
 According to the official information provided by the Nagaland State Lotteries, the winning number of   Dear Spark Wednesday , the 51st draw held at 1 pm Wednesday, is 38E 42562 the winner of the 1st prize will receive INR 1 crore for a ticket priced at INR 7. 
 Here is the official result of the Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Spark Wednesday at 1 pm on October 21, 2026 
 Nagaland State Lottery Sambad Dear Spark Wednesday result for October 21, 2026 
 Where to claim prizes 
 The winners of Nagaland State Lottery draws must present their winning tickets, along with a completed claim form available online, a government-recognized photo ID, and passport-size photographs in order to claim their prizes. 
 Nagaland State Lottery results are also accessible on the official Nagaland Lotteries website, Lottery Sambad, and Eastern Mirror. Director Zhothisa Dawhuo stated that the lottery results can also be viewed on YouTube chaunnels including Nagaland Lotteries, Nagaland Dear Lottery, Nagaland Lottery,  Nagaland State Lottery Live , and Nagaland Dear Laxmi.
